claims.title: 条件 DCF 将现价与终局经营假设联系起来
claims.original_summary: 在正利润、利润近似权益现金流、匀速到达终局并永久稳定的简化情景中，动态 PE 是终局利润倍数、增长年限及折现率的函数；它可帮助把价格改写为对未来经营条件的要求。有限参数区间内的年限敏感度较低，不意味着年限从公式消失。
assumptions: uniform growth to a declared terminal level
discount rate fixed for the illustrative derivation
next-year earnings used for forward PE
falsifiers_and_model_checks: Observed cash conversion or reinvestment materially violates the earnings-equals-cashflow approximation.
The declared formula fails to reconcile its own cashflow schedule.
Nonpositive earnings, finite asset life or structural decline makes the simplified PE model inapplicable.
A point estimate hides multiple compatible cashflow and discount combinations.
claims.counterevidence_to_empirical_extension: If independently supported terminal information does not improve predeclared out-of-sample observable-state prediction over an equal-information simple baseline, the claimed empirical increment is unsupported.
claim_limits: Formula consistency does not validate market efficiency.
Unchanged-forecast necessary-return derivations require distributions and fixed discounting.
No universal target price, growth irrelevance or return guarantee follows.

claims.title: 行业空间需要持续价值捕获与有效再投资
claims.original_summary: 行业需求扩大能否转为长期股东价值，取决于企业能否保留竞争优势并以超过资金成本的回报继续投资。共同技术扩散和产能扩张也可能压低优势；财务周转和现金转化可提供检验线索，不能单凭叙事或营收增速确认。
assumptions: advantage indicators are fixed before the outcome
economic cashflow and reinvestment are auditable
peer and demand-shock comparisons are economically comparable
advantage is durable and reproducible rather than only a temporary industry windfall
falsifiers_and_model_checks: Relative cost, share or bargaining advantage reverses despite the stated mechanism.
Incremental investment returns persistently fail the declared cost-of-capital comparison.
Apparent cash improvement arises only from payment deferral, financing, asset sales or accounting shifts.
Adequately informative out-of-sample comparisons exclude the predeclared useful incremental operating effect.
claims.counterevidence_to_empirical_extension: Demand-only or simple quality controls explain the outcome equally well after equal-information and capital-cycle matching.
claim_limits: ROIC does not automatically equal lifetime project IRR.
Accounting anomalies are not proof of fraud.
Nonlinear business growth or network effects alone do not establish ENG-X payoff convexity.

claims.title: 传播反馈与计价饱和可能改变利好的边际影响
claims.original_summary: 作者提出，关注、乐观预期与价格可能相互强化；当价格已要求较苛刻的终局条件，新增利好可能只维持旧预期，后续重估空间因而收窄。这是需要按市场制度、时点与竞争机制检验的假说，不是固定生命周期或安全追涨规律。
assumptions: original event and narrative boundary precede return inspection
joint operating and discount assumptions are disclosed
market regime, liquidity and short-sale conditions are recorded
new narrative episodes are not merged into old tests
falsifiers_and_model_checks: Out-of-sample response is systematically opposite to the predeclared conditional direction.
Apparent feedback is only repeated reporting of an existing price move.
Momentum, common risk premium or technical flow fully accounts for the claimed useful increment.
Event relabeling or posthoc parameter limits are necessary to obtain the claimed result.
claims.counterevidence_to_empirical_extension: At adequate precision, the predeclared minimum useful repricing increment is excluded; weak or missing evidence remains inconclusive.
claim_limits: Price co-movement is not causal proof.
A conservative/base/optimistic scenario set is not a hard capital-loss boundary.
The author explicitly allows counterexamples to relative-price heuristic claims.
